name: Dwarven Thrower
description: A runed warhammer of dark iron with a dwarf's face cast into its head.
body:
## What it does

In a dwarf's hand it strikes far truer and harder than a plain warhammer. Thrown, it flies true to 20 feet and as far as 60, hits harder still, and a giant takes the worst of it. After the throw it flies back to your hand.

damage.note: when thrown, or 2d8 against a giant

features.name: Return
features.text: Right after a ranged attack with it, it flies back to your hand.
